# OmicFlow

## Overview

OmicFlow is a generalised data structure for fast and efficient loading
of various sparse omics data. It can handle metataxonomics/metagenomics
data in text or
[BIOM](https://biom-format.org/documentation/format_versions/biom-2.0.html)
and extends to `proteomics` and other `omics` types. It also supports
non-sparse data, but it’s performance peaks in sparsity.

## Installation

The latest stable version can be installed from CRAN.

``` r

install.packages('OmicFlow', dependencies = TRUE)
```

The development version is available on GitHub.

``` r

install.packages('pak') # if not yet installed
pak::pkg_install('agusinac/OmicFlow@dev')
```

## Usage

Initialize the `metagenomics` or any `omics` object from a file-path or
pre-loaded object.

``` r
library("OmicFlow")

metadata_file <- system.file("extdata", "metadata.tsv", package = "OmicFlow")
counts_file <- system.file("extdata", "counts.tsv", package = "OmicFlow")
features_file <- system.file("extdata", "features.tsv", package = "OmicFlow")
tree_file <- system.file("extdata", "tree.newick", package = "OmicFlow")

taxa <- metagenomics$new(
    metaData = metadata_file,
    countData = counts_file,
    featureData = features_file,
    treeData = tree_file
)

taxa$feature_subset(Kingdom == "Bacteria")
taxa$scale(method = "tss")

# Access variables directly
taxa$metaData
taxa$countData
taxa$featureData
taxa$treeData

# Change variables & enjoy the automatic sync
taxa$featureData <- taxa$featureData[1:100, ]

# Inspect what functions variables are available to the class
taxa$
```

If you are new to `OmicFlow`, the best place to start is the
[Introduction to
OmicFlow](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/articles/getting-started.html).

## Docker

Example: **Outputs a `report.html` file in current work directory**

``` bash
docker pull agusinac/autoflow:latest

docker run -it --rm -v \
    "$(pwd)":/data \             # Mount the data in a temporary directory
    -w /data \                   # set working directory
    -u $(id -u):$(id -g) \       # non-root user
    agusinac/autoflow:latest \
    autoflow \                   # autoflow R script
    -b /data/biom_with_taxonomy_hdf5.biom \
    -m /data/metadata.tsv
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bray()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/bray.md) :
  Compute Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`canberra()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/canberra.md)
  : Compute Canberra Dissimilarity from a from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`colormap()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/colormap.md)
  : Color map of a variable
- [`column_exists()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/column_exists.md)
  : Checks if column exists in table
- [`composition_plot()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/composition_plot.md)
  : Compositional plot
- [`cosine()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/cosine.md)
  : Compute Cosine Dissimilarity from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`diversity()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/diversity.md)
  : Sparse implementation of Alpha Diversity Metrics
- [`diversity_plot()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/diversity_plot.md)
  : Diversity plot
- [`euclidean()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/euclidean.md)
  : Compute Euclidean Dissimilarity from a from a Dense or Sparse
  Matrix.
- [`hill_taxa()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/hill_taxa.md)
  : Sparse implementation of Hill numbers
- [`jaccard()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/jaccard.md)
  : Compute Jaccard Dissimilarity from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`jsd()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/jsd.md) :
  Compute Jensen-Shannon Divergence from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`manhattan()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/manhattan.md)
  : Compute Manhattan Dissimilarity from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`matrix_to_dtable()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/matrix_to_dtable.md)
  : Converting a Matrix to data.table
- [`metagenomics`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/metagenomics.md)
  : Sub-class metagenomics
- [`omics`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/omics.md) :
  Abstract omics class
- [`ordination_plot()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/ordination_plot.md)
  : Ordination plot
- [`pairwise_adonis()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/pairwise_adonis.md)
  : Pairwise adonis2 (PERMANOVA) computation
- [`pairwise_anosim()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/pairwise_anosim.md)
  : Pairwise anosim (ANOSIM) computation
- [`plot_pairwise_stats()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/plot_pairwise_stats.md)
  : Create pairwise stats plot
- [`proteomics`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/proteomics.md)
  : Sub-class proteomics
- [`unifrac()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/unifrac.md)
  : Compute UniFrac Dissimilarity from a Dense or Sparse Matrix.
- [`volcano_plot()`](https://agusinac.github.io/OmicFlow/reference/volcano_plot.md)
  : Volcano plot
